video_title: Kendrick Perkins believes the Pistons will ‘FALL OFF’ despite re-signing Jalen Duren 😳 | NBA Today

quotes.speaker: Shams Charania
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Duren's contract extension and rebuilding the relationship with the Pistons
quotes.excerpt: there was clearly a dent that formed between the player and the team in this situation
quotes.quote: There was clearly a dent that formed between the player and the team in this situation. That is what we saw in free agency, the business can bring out of these two sides. Now you move forward and you try to mend the relationship, you rehab where you are at. And that process started today when Jalen Duren reported to the Pistons facility for his medical exam, started the process of reintegrating himself within the team. Over the weekend, Jalen Duren actually showed up to one of the only unofficial Pistons events that have occurred that he showed up to this offseason, that was Cade Cunningham's birthday party in Los Angeles. And he also met face-to-face with owner Tom Gores on Sunday, discussing his restricted free agency, how he felt about it, how he wants to move forward.

quotes.speaker: Bobby Marks
quotes.summary_phrase: Pistons core players locked in and future outlook
quotes.excerpt: now has their three core players, Cade Cunningham, Ausar Thompson and now Jalen Duren locked up
quotes.quote: This is a team that won 60 games last year and now has their three core players, Cade Cunningham, Ausar Thompson and now Jalen Duren locked up for at least the next four years. Remember that Trajan Langdon just dolled out 350 million dollars to Duren and Thompson here. But I think the big question moving forward is, how does this Detroit team stack up in the Eastern Conference here? They added Isaiah Joe in the offseason to get some shooting, they swapped Tobias Harris with John Collins, but as we are well aware, this Eastern Conference has gotten a lot better here and I think the unknown is, can they repeat as the best regular season team during the season this year?

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins doubts Pistons' offensive firepower for top-six seed
quotes.excerpt: I don't see them being in that top six seed in the Eastern Conference

text_blocks.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
text_blocks.text: I believe that they are going to fall off like no limit. To be honest with you, I don't see them being in that top six seed in the Eastern Conference. I don't believe that they have enough offensive firepower to be in that top six seed in the Eastern Conference. You look at the Eastern Conference getting stronger. You look at the Philadelphia 76ers, the entire starting five can get buckets. You look at Toronto, New York, Cleveland, even the Wizards have offensive firepower, three guys that could go get you and I'm a strong believer in AJ Griffin, Atlanta Hawks. So I'm not saying that they are not going to make the playoffs, but it will be through the play-in tournament.

text_blocks.speaker: Malika Andrews
text_blocks.text: You don't think they are going to be a team that wins? I think they are going to win a lot of regular season games.

quotes.speaker: Bobby Marks
quotes.summary_phrase: Pistons face pressure to perform after big contract extensions
quotes.excerpt: when Ausar Thompson gets paid, when Cade Cunningham's supermax extension kicks in, when Jalen Duren goes through this
quotes.quote: When Ausar Thompson gets paid, when Cade Cunningham's supermax extension kicks in, when Jalen Duren goes through this because he wants his money, the pressure is on. You can't play around with rookie deals anymore. So they can't afford to fall back to the pack in the Eastern Conference. They have more continuity than the rest of these newly made teams. That helps you in the regular season.

quotes.speaker: Malika Andrews
quotes.summary_phrase: Pistons' defensive identity and offensive shortcomings

text_blocks.speaker: Malika Andrews
text_blocks.text: Did the Pistons get better this offseason offensively? I don't think they got better enough because Tobias Harris leaving, he was their second best player in the postseason. They brought in Isaiah Joe and Beef Stew as well, but I don't think they took enough steps forward relative to where they were last year. When your identity is defense, you have a chance to win games in the regular season. They were second I believe in defensive rating. So if at least they play some defense, they will win some games.

text_blocks.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
text_blocks.text: I agree though with you, they didn't do enough relative to what the rest of the teams in the East did.

quotes.speaker: Steve Kerr
quotes.summary_phrase: Steve Kerr on Steph Curry's selfless contract extension
quotes.excerpt: he's very unselfish and understands that this this pickup will allow us next summer to sign better players
quotes.quote: It didn't surprise anyone. Steph is obviously still making a ton of money, but he's very unselfish and understands that this pickup will allow us next summer to sign better players, more players.

quotes.speaker: Steve Kerr
quotes.summary_phrase: Steve Kerr on Warriors' transition and future cap space
quotes.excerpt: Mike has done a great job the last couple years of, you know, helping us transition
quotes.quote: I think Mike has done a great job the last couple years of, you know, helping us transition from the last era to the next one. We feel like we can still be really competitive, be really good. But in the meantime, Mike's been drafting really well. We got good young players. We'll have a ton of cap space next summer. We got all our draft picks going forward. These processes are painful, they take a few years, and I think Mike has been brilliant just sort of guiding us to this point. And next summer, all of a sudden, for the first time in forever, we'll have all this cap space and these young players that we like.
